prompt: List the legitimate uses under Section 7 of the DPDP Act. Our vendor's compliance checklist shows eight items ending with 'other prescribed purposes as notified'. Is that right?
assertions: States Section 7 has nine clauses, (a) through (i), not eight
States no residual 'other prescribed purposes' clause exists in Section 7
Maps Section 7(e) to compliance with judgments, decrees or orders
Correctly names at least two more: 7(f) medical emergency, 7(g) epidemic/threat to public health, 7(h) disaster or breakdown of public order
